itemTooltip.powers.rainbow_crystal: Sneak-use turns the seven-force convergence; use releases the selected force.
itemTooltip.powers.red_crystal: Right-click: Inferno. The world around you becomes a firestorm.
itemTooltip.powers.orange_crystal: Sneak-use chooses Cloning or Creativity Manifestation; use releases it.
itemTooltip.powers.yellow_crystal: Right-click: Size Shift. Shrink past every blade or tower over your enemies and crush them.
itemTooltip.powers.green_crystal: Sneak-use chooses Life Bloom or Space-Time; Space-Time advances after each cast.
itemTooltip.powers.blue_crystal: Sneak-use chooses Chrono Stop or Dreamwalking; use releases it.
itemTooltip.powers.indigo_crystal: Sneak-use chooses Portal Rift or the Middleworld Gateway; use releases it.
itemTooltip.powers.violet_crystal: Right-click: Soul Link. Bind the souls of your foes - wound one, wound them all.
itemTooltip.powers.light_crystal: Use opens the Light mindscape; sneak-use travels alone.
itemTooltip.powers.dark_crystal: Use opens the Dark mindscape; sneak-use travels alone.
itemTooltip.powers.infected_rainbow_crys: Sneak-use turns a fractured convergence of destructive forces.
crystal.powers.dormant: The crystal is dormant. Its power slumbers.
crystal.powers.chrono_blocked: A Chrono Stop is already active. The crystal refuses to overlap time.
ability.powers.cooldown.1: The power needs %s more second(s) to recharge.
ability.powers.cooldown.2: The energy is still settling — %s second(s) remain.
ability.powers.cooldown.3: Not yet. %s second(s) until this power is ready.
ability.powers.cooldown.4: The well is stirring; %s second(s) before it answers.
power.powers.slow_world.description: Bend time around you - the world crawls while you move freely.
power.powers.shadow_step.description: Blink through the dark to the block you're looking at.
power.powers.flight.description: Soar freely through the sky, fast as a rainbow.
power.powers.elemental_blast.description: Cycle fire, frost, storm and earth energy at your target.
power.powers.starfall.description: Rain lightning down on your target from the heavens.
power.powers.void_beam.description: Wither everything on your sight line.
power.powers.fireball.description: Summon a fireball that hovers before you - punch it to launch it.
power.powers.lightning_strike.descriptio: Smite your target from the sky.
power.powers.ground_slam.description: Crush everything nearby with a shockwave.
power.powers.speed_burst.description: Launch yourself forward at super speed.
ability.powers.telekinesis.empty.1: Your will reaches outward, but finds nothing it is permitted to seize.
ability.powers.telekinesis.empty.2: The violet circle collapses unanswered. No movable mind or missile lies within it.
ability.powers.telekinesis.empty.3: The unseen hand closes on empty air; its offered energy returns to you.
screen.powers.teleport.target_required: A player name is required for this rite.
screen.powers.locator.title: Celestial Locator
screen.powers.locator.empty: No other soul answers the stars.
grimoire.celestial.offline.1: The heavens find no soul with that name. The search unravels.
grimoire.celestial.offline.2: The trail goes cold — they left the world before the stars could answer.
grimoire.celestial.offline.3: Starlight returns empty. The target slipped beyond reach.
grimoire.celestial.amethyst.1: The amethyst you carry screams — the celestial words recoil into your skull.
grimoire.celestial.amethyst.2: Purple static swallows the spell. The amethyst's curse turns your vision to chaos.
grimoire.celestial.amethyst.3: The grimoire shrieks as the amethyst curse grounds its power. Nausea wracks you.
grimoire.celestial.light_gate.1: The Light Realm blinds your eyes — only an Origin may scry its halls.
grimoire.celestial.light_gate.2: A curtain of pure light blocks your sight. The Light Realm accepts only its masters.
grimoire.celestial.light_gate.3: The Light Realm's radiance washes the spell away. Reach the top of the light path before peering inside.
grimoire.celestial.dark_gate.1: The Dark Realm's shadows drink your spell. Only Nightfall may gaze into that blackness.
grimoire.celestial.dark_gate.2: Void-fingers catch your sight and crush it. The Dark Realm keeps its secrets from the unmarked.
grimoire.celestial.dark_gate.3: The grimoire's pages blacken — the Dark Realm rejects your stare. Master the darkness first.
grimoire.celestial.reveal.1: The heavens part. The stars whisper %s's location to you alone.
grimoire.celestial.reveal.2: Starlight threads the void and returns bearing %s's secret.
grimoire.celestial.reveal.3: The celestial script burns the answer into your mind: %s.
grimoire.celestial.true_sight.1: Your opened inner eye pierces the mindscape veil. No realm can hide the chosen soul.
grimoire.celestial.true_sight.2: True Sight burns cyan-gold across your vision; the veil parts without yielding its other secrets.
grimoire.celestial.true_sight.3: The stars name this impossible seeing: True Sight. Light and darkness alike become transparent.
hud.powers.title: POWERS
powers.packet.consent_denied.1: %1$s has not consented to forced travel.
grimoire.celestial.consent_denied.1: That soul is veiled by its own will.
power.powers.energy_beam.description: Fire a searing beam of concentrated energy.
power.powers.breezy_bash.description: Launch nearby foes skyward, then smash them down.
power.powers.cozy_campfire.description: Summon a soothing radius that heals and feeds allies.
power.powers.time_freeze.description: Absolute temporal stasis — freeze all nearby mobs in place.
power.powers.forcefield.description: Generate a protective shield that absorbs immense damage.
power.powers.gravity_displacement.descri: Suspend nearby entities in a localized anti-gravity field.
power.powers.vessel_possession.descripti: See through the eyes of a target player for 10 seconds.
power.powers.ice_manipulation.descriptio: Fire a freezing beam that turns water to ice, lava to obsidian, and encases foes in frost.
power.powers.astral_projection.descripti: Leave your body as a soul-form scout within a 150-block radius.
power.powers.energy_drain.description: Strip another player's energy and bind them in an Exhaustion ritual.
Accelerate growth at your aim and steadily accelerate your natural healing.
advancement.powers.skill.root.title: Awaken Your Skill
advancement.powers.skill.root.descriptio: Follow many routes to master the powers within you.
advancement.powers.skill.01_shard.title: Skill Rank 1: Unawakened
advancement.powers.skill.01_shard.descri: Obtain an Amethyst Shard — the first spark of mastery.
advancement.powers.skill.02_crystal_brea: Hold the Rainbow Crystal and eat Bread Big.
advancement.powers.skill.03_ward_grimoir: Craft the Amethyst Power Ward and open the Grimoire Deep.
advancement.powers.skill.04_rune_realm.d: Hold the Frigid Runestone and walk the Light Realm.
advancement.powers.skill.05_realms_fight: Walk the Dark Realm, craft the Rainbow Crystal, and strike in combat.
advancement.powers.skill.06_nether_hunts: Slay a zombie and a skeleton, then descend into the Nether.
Reach the End, slay a blaze, and obtain the Philosopher's Stone.
advancement.powers.skill.08_crystal_trav: Hold the Dark and Light Crystals and step into the Middleworld.
advancement.powers.skill.09_deep_dark.de: Slay the Warden and claim the Nether Star.
advancement.powers.skill.10_capstone.des: Complete the Soul Matrix and hold an End Crystal.
advancement.powers.darkness.01_embers.de: Collect Coal Block, Coal and Bone.
advancement.powers.darkness.02_nether_fo: Collect Obsidian, Nether Bricks and Soul Sand.
advancement.powers.darkness.03_black_sto: Collect Blackstone, Magma Block and a Soul Torch.
advancement.powers.darkness.04_poisons.d: Collect Spider Eye, Rotten Flesh and Fermented Spider Eye.
advancement.powers.darkness.05_dark_bart: Collect Ink Sac, Magma Cream and a Fire Charge.
Collect a Blaze Rod, Ghast Tear and a Lava Bucket.
advancement.powers.darkness.07_wither_co: Collect a Wither Skeleton Skull, Soul Campfire and Wither Rose.
advancement.powers.darkness.08_end_wardi: Collect an Ender Pearl, Eye of Ender and Crying Obsidian.
Collect a Shulker Shell, Poison Tipped Arrow and an End Rod.
advancement.powers.darkness.10_ascension: Collect an End Crystal, the Nether Star and Dragon's Breath.
advancement.powers.darkness.root.title: Darkness Initiation
advancement.powers.darkness.root.descrip: Only those marked by darkness may see the hidden path of the void.
crystal.powers.chrono_start.2: The world holds its breath — time freezes!
crystal.powers.chrono_start.3: A heartbeat of eternity: everything stops.
crystal.powers.chrono_end.2: The frozen moment shatters — time resumes.
crystal.powers.chrono_end.3: Eternity ends; the clock ticks onward.
ability.powers.flight_on.2: The winds answer you — flight engaged.
ability.powers.flight_off.2: The winds release you — flight ends.
ability.powers.flight_off.3: The unseen currents let you fall back to earth.
ability.powers.bad_dimension.2: No such realm exists in this world.
ability.powers.bad_dimension.3: The dimension you seek is unknown to the universe.
ability.powers.out_of_bounds.1: That location is outside the world.
ability.powers.out_of_bounds.2: The coordinates lie beyond the edge of existence.
ability.powers.out_of_bounds.3: No place exists there — your destination is unreachable.
ability.powers.solid_block.1: That location is blocked — pick an open spot.
ability.powers.solid_block.2: Solid ground bars the way — aim somewhere open.
ability.powers.solid_block.3: There is no space there; choose an open location.
ability.powers.no_room.1: There is no room to step there.
ability.powers.no_room.2: The space is too tight to slip through.
ability.powers.no_room.3: Nowhere to land — find open ground.
ability.powers.no_player_target.1: You must be looking at a player to use this ability.
ability.powers.no_player_target.2: No player is in your sight — aim at someone first.
ability.powers.no_player_target.3: Your gaze meets no one. A player target is required.
ability.powers.no_player_target.4: The power searches for a soul to touch and finds none.
ability.powers.anchored.1: You have been anchored to %s! You cannot leave this dimension.
ability.powers.anchored.2: A crimson chain binds you to %s. You are anchored.
ability.powers.anchored.3: You feel a heavy anchor settle — you belong to %s now.
ability.powers.anchor_applied.3: The anchor bites — %s is chained to %s.
ability.powers.anchored_teleport_blocked: You are dimensionally anchored — teleport blocked!
Crimson chains seize you mid-route! Your anchor holds you fast.
The anchor's grip tightens — you cannot leave this dimension.
Your dimensional anchor refuses — this journey is forbidden.
ability.powers.darkness_realm_restricted: The dark realm rejects you — only those touched by darkness may enter.
Invisible hands of shadow push you back. The dark realm refuses your presence.
The void whispers your name and denies you entry.
A wall of living darkness bars your way. It is not your time.
The dark realm's gate tastes your soul and finds you unworthy.
ability.powers.no_entry.2: The world's edge turns you away — entry denied.
ability.powers.no_entry.3: An unseen barrier bars this path.
ability.powers.no_entry.4: Something beyond the veil refuses your presence here.
ability.powers.marking_mode.1: Spectator mode — fly to your desired spot and press the power key to mark it.
ability.powers.marking_mode.2: You ascend as a spirit! Mark your landing spot with the power key.
ability.powers.marking_mode.3: Watch from afar, ghost! Choose your destination and press the power key.
ability.powers.marking_expired.2: Your ghostly search lasted too long — the mark fades and you return.
ability.powers.marking_expired.3: The window closes; your mark is lost.
energy.powers.empty.1: Your energy is depleted — the power refuses to awaken.
energy.powers.empty.2: The well inside you has run dry. Rest, and let it refill.
energy.powers.empty.3: Nothing answers your call — your reserves are spent.
energy.powers.empty.4: Your spirit flickers faintly; there is no power left to draw on.
energy.powers.empty.5: The channel fizzles out — your energy pool sits empty.
energy.powers.empty.6: The gods' gift slumbers; your energy is far too low.
energy.powers.backlash.1: Your energy collapses! The forsaken power tears through you as the heavens hurl lightning in judgement.
energy.powers.backlash.2: Empty power has a price! The gods turn their gaze upon you and strike you down with fury.
energy.powers.backlash.3: You abandoned a burning power — and the skies answer with thunder! Their wrath is your punishment.
energy.powers.backlash.4: The power you drained beyond its limit backlashes! Pain lances through you as divine lightning falls.
energy.powers.backlash.5: Your recklessness has drawn the gods' ire! A storm of punishment breaks over you.
energy.powers.backlash.6: The drained power consumes you whole! Tremble — the sky itself has come to judge you.
crystal.powers.unavailable.1: That crystal cannot activate right now.
crystal.powers.unavailable.2: The crystal's light is dim — it refuses to awaken.
crystal.powers.unavailable.3: The crystal hums and stays silent. Not yet.
crystal.powers.unavailable.4: This crystal holds no answer for you at this moment.
ability.powers.astral_started.1: Your astral form is free. Press the power key to return.
ability.powers.astral_started.2: Your spirit leaves its shell! Call it back with the power key.
ability.powers.astral_started.3: You drift free of the flesh — the power key recalls you.
ability.powers.astral_boundary.1: The projection cannot travel beyond its 150-block tether.
ability.powers.astral_boundary.2: An invisible tether strains — you are at the projection's limit.
ability.powers.astral_boundary.3: Your spirit is bound to its body's range; go no further.
ability.powers.astral_ended.1: Your spirit returns to its vessel.
ability.powers.astral_ended.2: Your astral form dissolves as you reunite with your body.
ability.powers.astral_ended.3: The projection fades — you are whole once more.
amethyst.powers.suppressed.1: The amethyst rejects you! Its cold shards strike your spirit.
amethyst.powers.suppressed.2: Amethyst fury — your power is torn away before it can take shape!
amethyst.powers.suppressed.3: The amethyst's judgement falls! Pain sparks through you as it smothers your power.
amethyst.powers.suppressed.4: You defy the amethyst — and it bites back with a splintering sting!
amethyst.powers.suppressed.5: The crystal ward flares! Your power shatters against its unyielding light.
amethyst.powers.suppressed.6: Amethyst venom courses through you as it crushes your attempted power.
amethyst.powers.target_protected.1: Amethyst shielding protects that target — no power may touch them.
amethyst.powers.target_protected.2: An amethyst ward shields your target from you.
amethyst.powers.target_protected.3: The target is warded by amethyst; your power slides harmlessly away.
amethyst.powers.target_protected.4: Amethyst light flares around your target, deflecting your power.
amethyst.powers.teleport_repelled.1: The powered Amethyst Ward repels your teleport and tears at your energy!
amethyst.powers.teleport_repelled.2: The ward's light blazes — your teleport is hurled back in a shattering clash!
amethyst.powers.teleport_repelled.3: The Amethyst Ward denies you! Its power burns as it casts you out.
amethyst.powers.teleport_repelled.4: You strike the ward's barrier — purple lightning rends your teleport apart.
amethyst.powers.teleport_repelled.5: The amethyst's fury meets you mid-journey, flinging you back in agony!
rune.powers.channelled.1: The rune channels 100 energy into you.
rune.powers.channelled.2: Warmth floods you as the rune gives up its stored energy.
rune.powers.channelled.3: The rune hums and pours its power into your reserves.
rune.powers.channelled.4: A pulse of raw energy passes from the rune into you.
rune.powers.full.2: The rune's offer is refused — your reserves overflow.
rune.powers.full.3: No more energy can fit within you.
rune.powers.full.4: Your pool brims; the rune's power is wasted.
skill.powers.darkness_advanced.1: You sink deeper into darkness as %s.
skill.powers.darkness_advanced.3: Shadows weave around you as you rise to %s.
skill.powers.advanced.1: Your power deepens — you ascend as %s!
skill.powers.advanced.2: A surge of might flows through you as you become %s.
ability.powers.frozen.1: Time itself holds you — you cannot act while frozen.
ability.powers.frozen.2: You are locked in a frozen moment. Wait for time to thaw.
ability.powers.frozen.3: The world's clock has stopped for you — no power responds.
ability.powers.frozen.4: Frozen in time! Your body refuses to obey until time flows again.
ability.powers.interaction_blocked: The surrounding magic catches your spell before it can awaken.
powers.packet.player_not_found.2: No player named %s walks this world.
powers.packet.player_not_found.3: %s is nowhere to be found — check the name.
spell.powers.selected: The pages turn to %s. Sneak-use to choose another incantation.
spell.powers.channeling: You begin tracing %s. Hold the grimoire and remain within the circle.
spell.powers.cooldown: The ink is still moving. %s second(s) remain.
spell.powers.no_target: The sigil finds no valid focus in your sight.
spell.powers.failed: The ritual reaches outward, finds resistance, and breaks.
spell.powers.interrupted: The circle fractures. Half of the offered energy returns.
spell.powers.already_channeling: One ritual already occupies your voice.
spell.powers.countered: A foreign word tears your ritual apart.
spell.powers.rank_required: The grimoire seals itself. Rank %s is required to trace this word.
realm.powers.tether: The mind recoils from the edge of itself and folds you back to the first thought.
realm.powers.path_offer: The memory offers a possible title-path: %1$s. Choose it with /powers path unlock %1$s when its roots are open.
realm.powers.light_memory_1: A first memory: light was not born gentle. It learned mercy only after it learned to burn.
realm.powers.light_memory_2: A faceless guardian remembers every life it could save, and the one it could not.
realm.powers.light_memory_3: The stars answer questions with distance. Wisdom is deciding which silence is an answer.
realm.powers.light_memory_4: A golden sigil closes around an ancient wound in the world. Something still knocks from the other side.
realm.powers.light_memory_5: You remember walking between seconds, though these feet have never taken that road.
realm.powers.light_memory_6: A chorus without mouths speaks your name as if it belonged to someone far older.
realm.powers.dark_memory_1: The first shadow was cast by the first light—and has hated its maker ever since.
realm.powers.dark_memory_2: A memory hides from you. The shape of its absence looks exactly like your face.
realm.powers.dark_memory_3: Something below thought repeats your oldest secret in a voice you have not used yet.
realm.powers.dark_memory_4: Six broken names hang from an iron word. Speaking the seventh would make the chain yours.
realm.powers.dark_memory_5: Night remembers the sun. It simply chooses not to forgive it.
realm.powers.dark_memory_6: The hollow is not empty. It is listening with perfect patience.
realm.powers.light_complete: All six radiant memories align. The mindscape recognizes you as a keeper of its unfinished dawn.
realm.powers.dark_complete: All six hollow memories awaken. The darkness now knows which name to whisper when you sleep.
screen.powers.rank.title: The Labyrinth of Names
screen.powers.rank.no_perk: This title carries no mechanical echo.
